map.吉他指板音位图 使用指南: Guitar Fretboard Note Map User Guide
map.交互式吉他指板，显示 1–24 品每根弦对应音名，支持调式/音阶高亮与点击播放试: Interactive guitar fretboard showing the note name of every string from frets 1-24, with mode/scale highlighting and click-to-play preview. For memorizing fretboard positions, finding chord voicings and scale practice.
map.查某弦某品的实际音名与频率，背指板或扒谱: Look up the actual note name and frequency at a given string and fret, for memorizing the fretboard or transcribing
map.给定根音看音阶/和弦在指板上的位置分布: Given a root note, see how a scale or chord is distributed on the fretboard
map.校音时对照空弦频率（如标准调弦 EADGBE）: Check against open string frequencies when tuning (for example standard tuning EADGBE)
map.：十二平均律每品升半音：f = 空弦频率 × 2^(品/12)。高音 E 弦空弦: : In twelve-tone equal temperament each fret rises by a semitone: f = open string frequency x 2^(fret/12). The high E string open is E4 = 329.63 Hz, so the 12th fret = 329.63 x 2 = 659.26 Hz (E5, exactly one octave higher).
map.：从低到高 E2(82.41) A2(110) D3(146.83) G3(19: : from low to high E2 (82.41), A2 (110), D3 (146.83), G3 (196), B3 (246.94), E4 (329.63); the 5th fret of the low E string = A2 (110 Hz), the same as the neighbouring open string, so they can be cross-checked.
map.为什么第 12 品是高八度？: Why is the 12th fret an octave higher?
map.12 个半音 = 一个八度，频率×2^(12/12)=×2，故空弦第 12 品正: 12 semitones = one octave, frequency x 2^(12/12) = x2, so the 12th fret of an open string is exactly one octave higher, and this holds for every string.
map.空弦频率怎么记？: How do you remember the open string frequencies?
map.标准调弦低到高 E A D G B E；相邻弦（除 G-B 为纯四度+小三度）多: Standard tuning low to high is E A D G B E; adjacent strings mostly differ by a perfect fourth (5 semitones) except G-B (perfect fourth plus minor third), so memorizing E2/A2/D3/G3/B3/E4 lets you derive all frets.
